name: Hawaii DOH Clean Water Branch water quality advisories and events (eha-cloud CWB portal API)
operator: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
waters_covered: statewide coastal waters, streams and harbors; all islands
access_detail: Public AngularJS portal https://eha-cloud.doh.hawaii.gov/cwb/ calls api/events. GET with header 'Accept: application/json' returns JSON {page,totalResultsCount,list} (without it, an HTML snapshot). No auth. Returns the newest 500 of 1,898 events (2023-01 to 2026-11-03); page/skip/take parameters were ignored, so deeper history needs the right paging parameter (unknown). Sample raw/cwb-events-sample.json (createdBy/updatedBy staff emails removed). Email notifications by island via the portal's subscription form.

sample_record.title: Wastewater Discharge at Kalama Park, Kihei, Maui
sample_record.description: Event: Discharge of wastewater from a manhole / Location: Kihei Pump Station #6 ... / Volume: Undetermined / Status of spill: Ongoing / Affected waters: Beach fronting Kalama Park / Warning signs have been posted. The public is advised to remain out of the affected waters until this advisory has been cancelled.

fills_event_fields: valid_until / ended_at of the advisory (closedDate, signRemovalDate)
cannot_fill: spill start time as a field (sometimes in text)
cadence: Posted by DOH as notices are issued; the newest Brown Water Advisory was posted 2026-11-03 21:09 UTC, minutes before the fetch. Sewage Spill advisories stayed open a median 6.8 days (n=50).
history: 1,898 events since at least 2023-01; types in newest 500: Brown Water Advisory 280, Beach Notification 104, Beach Advisory 51, Sewage Spill 50, Permit Exceedance 15.
legal_basis: HAR 11-62 Appendix B (wastewater spills, overflows and discharges); HAR 11-55 NPDES
status_reason: Statewide, machine-readable, dated authority advisories with open/closed status: Tier A. Sewage Spill and Permit Exceedance give the red window (DOH's own: 'remain out of the affected waters until this advisory has been cancelled'). Brown Water Advisories are rain-runoff advisories: a separate category.
notes: Undocumented API behind a public page; descriptionHtml contains links. Titles sometimes carry a street address.

name: HAR 11-62 Appendix B: responses for wastewater spills, overflows and discharges
status_reason: Owner or agent reports spills to the Clean Water Branch; deadline text not read (Justia blocks scripted reads).

name: HAR 11-55 Water pollution control (NPDES; standard permit conditions)
status_reason: NPDES authority; a draft amendment was out for comment Jan-Feb 2026 (search).

status_reason: Large spills also get a press release; the CWB API is the systematic channel.
